import json

# exp_011
d = json.load(open('/root/spectral_collapse_ews/results/phase1_fixed_mix_r02_seed42_results.json'))
d.sort(key=lambda x: x['generation'])
print('=== exp_011 (fixed_mix r=0.2, seed42) ===')
print(f'Completed gens: {len(d)}')
for item in d:
    g = item['generation']
    print(f'  gen_{g}: log_det={item[\"log_det\"]:.2f}, eff_rank={item[\"effective_rank\"]:.2f}, ppl={item[\"perplexity\"]:.4f}, distinct4={item[\"distinct_4\"]:.4f}')

slv = [item['log_det'] for item in d]
alpha = 0.5
ema = [slv[0]]
for t in range(1, len(slv)):
    ema.append(alpha * slv[t] + (1-alpha) * ema[-1])

S0 = abs(ema[0])
delta = [None]
for t in range(1, len(slv)):
    delta.append((ema[t-1] - ema[t]) / S0)

print()
print('Gen | raw SLV  | EMA SLV  | delta_t')
for t in range(len(slv)):
    d_str = f'{delta[t]:+.6f}' if delta[t] is not None else '---'
    print(f'{t:3d} | {slv[t]:8.2f} | {ema[t]:8.2f} | {d_str}')

for start in range(2, len(ema)):
    all_nondec = all(ema[i] >= ema[i-1] for i in range(start, len(ema)))
    if all_nondec:
        print(f'EMA non-decreasing from Gen {start} onward')
        break
else:
    print('No sustained EMA non-decreasing segment found')

print(f'Final SLV: {slv[-1]:.2f} (baseline: {slv[0]:.2f}, change: {(slv[-1]-slv[0])/slv[0]*100:+.2f}%)')
pos_deltas = [(t, delta[t]) for t in range(1, len(delta)) if delta[t] is not None and delta[t] > 0]
if pos_deltas:
    max_t, max_d = max(pos_deltas, key=lambda x: x[1])
    print(f'max delta_t = {max_d:+.6f} at Gen {max_t}')
else:
    print('No positive delta_t (no collapse signal)')
"

# exp_010
d = json.load(open('/root/spectral_collapse_ews/results/phase1_pure_collapse_seed43_results.json'))
d.sort(key=lambda x: x['generation'])
print('=== exp_010 (pure_collapse, seed43) ===')
print(f'Completed gens: {len(d)}')
for item in d:
    g = item['generation']
    print(f'  gen_{g}: log_det={item[\"log_det\"]:.2f}, eff_rank={item[\"effective_rank\"]:.2f}, ppl={item[\"perplexity\"]:.4f}, distinct4={item[\"distinct_4\"]:.4f}')

slv = [item['log_det'] for item in d]
alpha = 0.5
ema = [slv[0]]
for t in range(1, len(slv)):
    ema.append(alpha * slv[t] + (1-alpha) * ema[-1])

S0 = abs(ema[0])
delta = [None]
for t in range(1, len(slv)):
    delta.append((ema[t-1] - ema[t]) / S0)

print()
print('Gen | raw SLV  | EMA SLV  | delta_t')
for t in range(len(slv)):
    d_str = f'{delta[t]:+.6f}' if delta[t] is not None else '---'
    print(f'{t:3d} | {slv[t]:8.2f} | {ema[t]:8.2f} | {d_str}')

for start in range(2, len(ema)):
    all_nondec = all(ema[i] >= ema[i-1] for i in range(start, len(ema)))
    if all_nondec:
        print(f'EMA non-decreasing from Gen {start} onward')
        break
else:
    print('No sustained EMA non-decreasing segment found')

print(f'Final SLV: {slv[-1]:.2f} (baseline: {slv[0]:.2f}, change: {(slv[-1]-slv[0])/slv[0]*100:+.2f}%)')
pos_deltas = [(t, delta[t]) for t in range(1, len(delta)) if delta[t] is not None and delta[t] > 0]
if pos_deltas:
    max_t, max_d = max(pos_deltas, key=lambda x: x[1])
    print(f'max delta_t = {max_d:+.6f} at Gen {max_t}')
else:
    print('No positive delta_t (no collapse signal)')
